whole_gland_secretion.AE4_KO_timecourse: Comparable to WT for initial 2-3 min, then sustained reduction after approximately 3 min.
whole_gland_secretion.AE2_KO: Essentially identical secretion kinetics and total output to strain-matched control; n=6 each. Verify/digitize source figure if quantitative time-course constraints are used.
whole_gland_secretion.source_locator: JBC 2015 Results first section; Figure 1A and 1B captions
whole_gland_secretion.AE4_KO_late_timecourse: After approximately 3 min sustained output is stated to be less than half WT; this is a qualitative textual constraint, not a digitised timepoint series.
whole_gland_secretion.strain_warning: AE4 is BS/129Svj; AE2 C57Bl/6. Source explicitly reports strain differences in initial control secretion kinetics; retain within-strain genotype comparisons and do not treat distinct controls as one observed timecourse.

salivary_HCO3_output.source_locator: JBC 2015 Results paragraph immediately after Table 1
salivary_HCO3_output.method_caveat: Methods state division of concentration by collected saliva amount, which is dimensionally inconsistent with reported microequiv. Preserve published output values without silently repairing raw calculation. No raw concentrations or volumes available here.

isolated_NKCC1.protocol: HCO3-free; 30 uM ethoxyzolamide; 50 uM T16Ainh-A01; Cl depletion followed by readdition.
isolated_NKCC1.genotype_result: No statistically detectable difference in NKCC1-dependent initial Cl uptake among control, AE4 KO and AE2 KO under this assay.
isolated_NKCC1.constraint_rule: Do not translate non-significance into exact equality or an invented numerical tolerance. Simulate the assay protocol separately.
isolated_NKCC1.control_pooling: Figure pools distinct AE4 WT and AE2 control genotypes after detecting no difference; n=16 refers pooled control experiments.

NHE_assay.genotype_result: No statistically detectable difference in stimulation-induced NHE-mediated alkalinisation among control, AE4 KO and AE2 KO.
NHE_assay.EIPA: 10 uM EIPA reverses the stimulated alkalinisation to acidification; n=7.
NHE_assay.constraint_rule: A reconstruction must not obtain AE4-KO rescue failure by strongly suppressing NHE activity.
NHE_assay.measurement: Initial slope of normalised BCECF 490/440 ratio F/F0, not direct NHE molar flux.
NHE_assay.control_pooling: AE4 WT and AE2 control experiments pooled after no significant difference.

isolated_HCO3_dependent_exchanger.protocol_note: B+ physiological solution; first deplete at external Cl=4mM, then add 50uM bumetanide and 50uM T16Ainh-A01 while still depleted, then restore external Cl=128.3mM with both inhibitors retained.

AE4_KO.control: pooled AE4 WT and AE2 control

AE2_KO.control: pooled AE4 WT and AE2 control

nonnegotiable_rules: Use one shared scientific parameter vector across genotypes and protocols.
Give each established knockout its own relaxed resting state; do not use a shared WT initial state as the primary comparator.
Genotype changes only the experimentally deleted transporter; do not fit genotype-specific capacity multipliers.
Protocol changes only documented agonists, extracellular solution, inhibitors and source-supported signalling inputs.
Do not equate a non-significant difference with exact equality.
Do not invent numerical tolerances such as 5% or 10%.
Whole-gland outputs must be compared via ratios and time-course shape unless an acinus-to-gland scale is independently justified.
SPQ fluorescence observables require an explicit observation operator or a documented normalized comparison; do not identify them directly with fmol/s transporter flux.
Do not tune solely to the approximately 35% saliva endpoint.
Do not perform a Cartesian-product sweep or mechanism-family search.

If the inherited AE4 law lacks beta-adrenergic/cAMP/PKA activation, treat the smallest AE4-specific activation mechanism as the first documented equation correction, and fit it to isolated exchanger data rather than secretion.
After that, allow at most one additional equation-level correction, only if a specific residual pattern and independent evidence require it.

verification.uncertainty: All JBC 2015 results mean plus or minus SE. SE refers to uncertainty of experimental mean; not a hard bound and not biological SD.
verification.n_definition: Number of experiments; separate preparations from at least three different mice for each condition. Do not identify every experiment with an independent animal.
verification.supplement_status: No supplementary data link identified in primary full HTML; numerical seed verified against main Table 1, figure captions and Results.

additional_verified_primary_constraints.note: Joint inhibition in depletion/readdition assay, not NKCC alone.
Source phrase says reduced to 96.3% of control but context means a 96.3% reduction (near absence); do not use as a hard numerical constraint without checking figure or raw data.

additional_verified_primary_constraints.result: No initial Cl exit detected; relatively slow net uptake observed.

critical_CCh_IPR_contrast.protocol_match: Same physiological B+, same CCh0.3uM, added IPR5uM; same SPQ F0/F normalisation. Results explicitly refer single agonist experiments to Fig1C/D protocol.
